facts.summary: Steve Shickles's static personal website: index.html, error.html and a CNAME for steveshickles.com. No build, backend or packages.

deployments.name: Website
deployments.trigger: push to master or manual run of static.yml, which uploads the whole repository root; a merge to dev does not publish

services.name: GitHub Pages
services.purpose: Hosts the site published from master; CNAME sets the custom domain steveshickles.com.

services.name: GitHub Actions
services.purpose: Runs the required checks job on PRs and the static.yml Pages workflow on master.

services.name: Greptile
services.purpose: Reviews every PR; its approval is a required check.
